question: Should this protected, maintainer-commissioned Control UI refactor be approved after the current-base lifecycle review and pending CI complete?
rationale: The `maintainer` label prevents automated cleanup, and the refactor moves stateful session, queue, and rendering orchestration across several modules where maintainers must confirm the intended ownership and acceptable review scope.

options.title: Approve after final lifecycle review
options.body: Confirm route restoration, queued-send delivery, Gateway-event reconciliation, and render scheduling preserve the existing facade contract, then merge after required checks pass.

options.title: Request narrower follow-up changes
options.body: Keep the facade and ownership split, but request a focused correction if the current-base review identifies a moved lifecycle invariant or test gap.
